_comment: Story scene carrying a mirrored cutscene dialogue log — exercises components/story/LogPanel.vue via the scene === 'story' branch in app.vue. Covers every row variant the panel distinguishes: a speaker with both title and portrait, a speaker with a portrait but no title, embedded newlines rendered via white-space: pre-line, a speaker whose portrait slug resolves to nothing (404 fallback to name-only), a Monologue row whose name line is suppressed, and both choice-outcome accents.

storyLog.title: Ex-Grade 1 Fixer
storyLog.content: So this is the Library. Cosier than the rumours made it sound.

You are late.
The guests have already arrived.

storyLog.title: Floor of General Works
storyLog.content: Welcome back, Roland. Please try not to break anything this time.
The lights dim. Somewhere far below, a page turns on its own.
